docs.summary: StatusDot component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use StatusDot to communicate status or feedback to users. This component provides visual indicators that help users understand the current state or outcome.
StatusDot is effective for showing status, progress, or results. Use it consistently throughout your application to maintain clear communication patterns.

anatomy.description: StatusDot is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate severity
bestPractices.description: Match the status-dot visual style to the message importance.

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing too many status-dot instances at once.

bestPractices.title: Provide context
bestPractices.description: Include clear, actionable information in the status-dot.

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistency
bestPractices.description: Use the same patterns throughout your application.
